name: devstral-small-2-24b
about: Mistral AI Devstral Small 2 24B Instruct (2512), a coding model, published only in FP8. Apache-2.0, EU vendor. DOES NOT RUN ON THE A100 with vLLM 0.29 (2026-09-27): with the defaults, torch.compile's inductor fails ('auto_functionalized was not removed', as Ministral 3's FP8 did on an A40); with --enforce-eager, the FP8 matrix kernel for the A100's generation fails (cutlass_scaled_mm_sm80). There is no BF16 release to fall back on. It may run on an Ada, Hopper or Blackwell card, which have FP8 in hardware; those come after the A100s in the list. Settings every Mistral 3 model needed: vLLM v0.29.0, Mistral's own format, reasoning_effort none.
cards: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
